comment: Read from src/Junction at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Junction. The wiki does not mention the Clamp while summing menu item (Widget.cpp:78), which decides whether the ±10V clamp is applied after each input is added or only once after the last; with it off, two inputs well past 5V can cancel rather than clip. Channels that an input does not carry are masked to zero (Junction.cpp:120) rather than repeating its last channel. The jacks and outputs carry whatever is patched into them, so they are given no family.
